isomorphisms.prediction: Breaking a law-sector symmetry will kill exactly its own Noether charge with selectivity >10^10.

Constructive term active when charge conserved
Destructive term = name of lost charge when symmetry broken

symmetry broken → charge lost maps to symmetry broken → destructive term active
conservation law as mathematical consequence maps to spiritual term as forced, not chosen
